ruleDefinitions.name: Host Without Firewall
ruleDefinitions.description: Host Without Firewall. Alert means not complied. Sigma for Qualys vulnerability scanner. Scan type - Vulnerability Management. Note: Unmapped fields: event.category, host.scan.vuln_name

sequences.query: (event.category = "Security\ Policy" AND host.scan.vuln_name = RGX(".*Firewall\\ Product\\ Not\\ Detected.*"))
